context_requirements: Expression of PDK1-4 (especially PDK1) so that PDH is actively inhibited at baseline
Intact PDH complex (PDHA1, DLAT, DLD) allowing reactivation upon PDK inhibition
Glycolytic/Warburg metabolic phenotype with high lactate production and reliance on glycolysis
Functional mitochondria and oxidative phosphorylation capacity to switch to
TP53 wild-type or functional for maximal apoptotic/anti-proliferative response
falsifiers: No decrease in glycolysis-associated transcripts (LDHA, SLC2A1, HK2, PKM) at 6-24 h in any line
No increase in oxidative phosphorylation or TCA-cycle transcripts (PDHX, SDHB, SLC25A4) at 24 h
Absence of any transcriptional response across all nine lines (magnitude none at both timepoints)
No antiproliferative signature (proliferation_down) at 24 h in glycolytic lines such as HEPG2 or A549

evidence.supports: PDK inhibitor dichloroacetate shifts HCC cells from glycolysis to oxidative phosphorylation and reduces viability, supporting metabolic reprogramming and antiproliferative effects
PDK inhibitor conjugate increases ROS and induces apoptosis/ferroptosis in cancer cells
DCA activates PDH and causes metabolic rewiring in human macrophages, showing cell-type-specific transcriptional effects
DCA represses inflammatory gene expression in liver and macrophages, indicating anti-inflammatory transcriptional consequences
DCA alters metabolic and senescence-associated programs in lung macrophages, supporting context-dependent transcriptional responses

changes: Moved GAPDH from proximal_down to proximal_up: PDK inhibition activates PDH and increases glycolytic flux, so glycolytic enzymes are expected to be up, not down.
Moved ALDOA from proximal_down to proximal_up: same rationale as GAPDH; PDK inhibition does not directly repress glycolytic gene transcription.
Moved BNIP3 from proximal_down to proximal_up: PDK inhibition stabilizes HIF1A, which induces BNIP3; BNIP3 is not a direct PDK target.
Removed SLC25A4 from proximal_up because it is already listed in late_up; a gene cannot appear in both an up and a down list of the same time, and duplicate up entries are redundant.

Removed generic proliferation genes (CCND1, CCNE2, CDK2, MCM3, PCNA, TOP2A, AURKA, BIRC5, CCNB1, CDK1, E2F2, MYBL2) from late_down and placed them under generic_effects as proliferation_down/g1_arrest, since they are not proximal PDK targets.
Removed generic stress/apoptosis genes (BNIP3, PMAIP1, GADD45A, etc.) from proximal lists; they belong to generic_effects oxidative_stress/apoptosis.

Corrected line_response: HEPG2 changed from strong to moderate because the cited evidence shows DCA reduces viability but does not establish a strong transcriptional response; A549 changed from moderate to weak because no direct evidence supports a moderate response in this line.
Corrected kinetics from slow to moderate: DCA-induced metabolic and transcriptional changes occur within hours, not days, based on the cited abstracts.
Corrected magnitude: 6h changed from weak to moderate and 24h from moderate to strong to reflect the rapid and robust transcriptional reprogramming reported for PDK inhibition.
Removed primary_targets PDPK1, CDK2, CHEK1, GSK3B, KDR because the cited abstracts do not support these as direct targets of pyruvate dehydrogenase kinase inhibitors; only PDK1 is supported.

Removed evidence PMID 34552598, 39621302, and 41761973 because their abstracts do not support the stated claims about transcriptional effects in the context of this experiment; they describe macrophage or liver effects, not the nine cell lines profiled.
